static_verification.area: optimality selection arithmetic and exact lower KKT oracle
static_verification.detail: OptimalityMasks only groups the same lower_active, upper_active, and initial_free references. select_optimality_release contains the prior sort expression unchanged: None precedes Some, finite ratios sort by descending total_cmp, and exact ties use ascending coordinate. Candidate creation, h/tau division, KKT accounting, free-refusal accumulation, and selected-release construction retain their order. This preserves the accepted lower-bound oracle: the normalized tie selects coordinate 0 then coordinate 1, with second h [0,-2,2,6,0] and unchanged final step/h.

The extracted call chain preserves the original order: signed-zero lambda eligibility; p0 assembly; active and free-box admission; ordered p0 norm and strict radius predicate; attempted-entry reservation; factor lookup; first residual; first factor application; first coordinate updates; test-only position-1 mutation; p1 box, active, norm, and radius guards; second residual; second factor application; second coordinate updates; test-only position-2 mutation; final box and active guards; final norm and radius guards; trace snapshots; final step installation and refined flag. No floating operation, comparison, clamp, guard, or installation moved across another numerical operation.

refinement_reserve_work retains attempted_entries increment before both checked_sub operations, scalar-underflow refusal before guard-underflow refusal, the same short-circuit scalar-cap then guard-cap predicate, one denied_entries increment on each refusal, and no counter charge after denial. Eligibility scalar/guard deltas are still captured after eligibility and before reservation. Both factor helpers preserve the before snapshot, lambda_step call, factor-application delta, output guards, and absorb order. Residual, coordinate-update, whole-KKT, and upward-enclosure ledger sources remain unchanged.

RefinementFailureSite groups the existing correction position, guard stage, row, term, coordinate, and scratch-box feasibility without changing any call-site value. Every former refinement_metadata_refusal and refinement_dot2_metadata_refusal argument maps one-for-one. Reason mapping, original trust radius from input.initial_radius, reduced face radius from solution.radius, active/free masks, lambda, and canonical boxed work remain unchanged. Observation helper labels retain refinement_p0_missing, refinement_delta0_missing, refinement_p1_missing, refinement_residual1_missing, refinement_delta1_missing, refinement_observation_missing, refinement_work_cap, and the typed optimality reason fallback.

Removed original_lower, original_upper, base, scale, and redundant radius members were never consumed by refinement_mutate; its match arms previously ignored them through '..'. The retained mutation still consumes only coordinate/scaled_value and ScratchRadius.radius at the same positions. Production guards still read canonical prepared bounds, live state, input.initial_radius, and solution.radius. The FinalBox, ScratchRadius, and ActiveValue helper retains reason, correction position, stage, coordinate, lower/upper/free masks, lambda, both radius sources, scratch feasibility, unchanged live state, global snapshot, and restored nondefault budget assertions.

The final control first solves the retained capture with input.initial_radius and solution.radius both exactly 1.0, then mutates only input.initial_radius to 2.0, proves the operands unequal, installs the existing P0Subnormal mutation, and invokes refine_face_before_crossing. It requires the same first-correction ResidualSourceWeight refusal at row 0, term 14, coordinate 13 and exact metadata original=2.0/reduced=1.0. This corrects the preserved prior failed construction that changed the radius before solving.

The success/refusal context helpers move the same trace and refusal fields into the same output fields. Bit collection remains in p0, delta0, p1, residual1, delta1, p2 order and as_ref().iter().map(to_bits) is value-equivalent to consuming into_iter().map(to_bits). Pre-refinement lower/upper copies remain captured before refinement; p0/p1/p2 fallbacks use those copies and exit fallbacks use final state masks. Factor identities, correction count, feasibility booleans, KKT coordinate values/classes, and all work counters are copied from the same sources. The removed p1_box_feasible trace/output field had no assertion consumer; the live local remains passed to every typed refusal and guard.

assert_retained_face_observation_core retains every bitwise p0/delta0/p1/residual1/delta1/p2, h/cbar/tau, class, box, and ball assertion. assert_retained_face_observation_accounting retains factor reuse, all masks, two corrections, phase work totals, upward bounds, and case-specific totals. assert_scratch_mutation_refusal retains the entire original typed refusal/state/hook/budget assertion body. One identical bvls02_pass assertion is repeated in the caller; it does not weaken coverage.
